meta.title: Warren Buffett Gets Paid $800,000,000 a Year For a Decision He Made in 1994
meta.hook: This man hasn't bought a share of Coca-Cola since 1994.
meta.description: Warren Buffett spent $1.3 billion buying 400 million shares of Coca-Cola between 1988 and 1994 and hasn't bought a single share since. Those shares paid $75 million in dividends in 1994. By 2022 the same shares paid $704 million. Coca-Cola has raised its dividend for more than 60 consecutive years. This is dividend compounding in the real world, and why doing nothing is the hardest strategy in investing.

scenes.narration: This man hasn't bought a single share of Coca-Cola since nineteen ninety-four.
